decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the bus fare policy currently in force, the National Transport Commission is required to announce the revision of bus fares on 01st July every year. Accordingly, the National Transport Commission has appointed a Committee to submit recommendations for updating and revising the existing bus fare formula (cost index) and fare structure, paying attention to the frequent fluctuations in fuel prices due to the war situation prevailing in the Middle East region from February 2026, and the associated operating costs, the types of buses currently in service, the impact of fluctuations in the value of the US dollar on the cost of bus spare parts, buses operating on expressways and the low-floor buses recently introduced operating under Lanka Metro Transit (Private) Limited, and taking into account the provision of continuous transport services to the public and the safety of the bus industry. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to revise bus fares by the National Transport Commission, taking also into account the fuel price revision made to be effective from 2026-06-30, as per the recommendations submitted by the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
